justifications.r1: 4-color landfall triggers produce {W}{U}{B}{R} and 4 mana on second land drop.
justifications.r2: Omnath draws a card on ETB; landfall engines draw cards on every land.
justifications.a1: Fetchlands, land tutors (Crop Rotation, Scapeshift), and ramp spells.
justifications.a2: Explosive landfall loops running by Turns 4–5.
justifications.p1: Presents massive landfall damage and board swarm on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 2 opponent untap steps for combat, or burn damage from Omnath third trigger.
justifications.i1: Fierce Guardianship, Swords to Plowshares, Beast Within.
justifications.s2: Splendid Reclamation and Ramunap Excavator recur lands from graveyard.
justifications.s3: Landfall pieces function, but Omnath is the marquee engine.
